bearer.description: kn_ API key or ks_ session token (AUTH_MODE=api-key)

token.description: kr_ token from the reset link

password.description: Optional initial password; omit to let the user set one via password reset

disabled.description: true disables authentication for this user (soft delete)

password.description: Admin password override; revokes the user sessions

projectId.description: Owning project; must belong to workspaceId

parentId.description: Feature 08 nesting: create under this document

revisionId.description: line: revision the line number refers to (source head at comment time)

line.description: line: 1-based new-side line number in the diff

excerpt.description: line: text excerpt for best-effort re-matching once the branch advances

quote.description: text: the selected passage, as rendered (feature 13 review mode)

prefix.description: text: rendered text immediately before the quote, for disambiguation

suffix.description: text: rendered text immediately after the quote, for disambiguation

entityKey.description: entity: graph entity key, e.g. service:identity

resolvable.description: True (the default) starts a resolvable thread; false posts a plain comment that cannot be resolved.

source.description: Who opened it. Defaults to 'human'; 'ai' marks a finding posted from an assistant review.

replyToId.description: Comment in this thread that the reply answers

targetBranch.description: Defaults to the document's default branch

isDraft.description: Draft merge requests cannot be merged

assigneeId.description: Workspace member to assign; null clears the assignee

reviewerIds.description: Replace-set of reviewer user ids (workspace members)

depth.description: Entity hops from the vector hits

relationTypes.description: Relation edge types to follow (default: all)

categories.description: Only return documents in these categories (feature 02)

projectIds.description: Only return documents in these projects

tags.description: Only return documents carrying any of these tags

query.example: SELECT documentId, targetKey, confidence FROM DEPENDS_ON

instruction.example: Draft an outline for the missing sections

question.example: Why do sessions get revoked on password reset?

text.description: Draft text (an excerpt is used as the search query)

documentId.description: Page the pane was opened from — default chat grounding

title.description: null clears the manual title so the auto-derived one shows again

providerId.description: Provider profile to run this thread on; null returns it to the workspace default

content.example: Draft a short onboarding page for new hires

documentId.description: Overrides the thread's default grounding document for this turn

mode.description: 'ask' (default) excludes write tools this turn regardless of role; 'agent' allows them (still gated by editor role)

attachments.description: Ephemeral file content for this turn only — not persisted verbatim into thread history

documentRefs.description: Existing workspace documents manually picked to ground this turn in ("Apply documents" widget)

skillIds.description: Skills (docs/features/12) explicitly applied to this turn; enabled skills also join on trigger match

apiKey.description: Write-only. Omit to keep the stored key; null or "" clears it and falls back to ASSISTANT_API_KEY.

agentModeEnabled.description: Allow Agent mode (write tools) in the chat for this workspace

workspaceMonthlyTokenBudget.description: Monthly workspace token budget; null = unlimited

defaultUserMonthlyTokenBudget.description: Default per-user monthly budget; null = unlimited

enforceBudget.description: Refuse assistant requests once a budget is spent (429)

chatProviderId.description: Provider profile serving chat and agent turns

reviewProviderId.description: Provider profile serving draft review and suggestions

extractionProviderId.description: Provider profile serving the worker's relation extraction

providerId.description: Test one profile instead of whatever chat is routed at

apiKey.description: Write-only; omit to keep, null to clear

description.example: Draft release notes from merged merge requests

instructions.description: Markdown instructions merged into the system prompt

triggers.description: Keywords that pull this skill into a turn

enabledTools.description: Tools offered to the model; empty = every discovered tool

authValue.description: Write-only; omit to keep, null to clear

projectId.description: Project the term belongs to (must be in the same workspace)

sizeBytes.description: Claimed size; re-checked against the bucket before parsing
